svg.title: A uniform droplet grid under a Gaussian beam
svg.desc: Pitch ell defines number density; bubble radius R defines gas void fraction alpha. The inherited beam has w0 25 micrometres and cannot excite a 40 micrometre grid uniformly.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Uniform droplet placement is not uniform activation

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 液滴均匀分布不代表均匀激活
